title: Ford Credit 2024-A Servicing Report
subtitle: August 2026 Collection Period Summary

overview.text: This brief summarizes the August 2026 servicing report for the Ford Credit 2024-A asset-backed securities. The report covers the collection period ending August 2026, with a scheduled payment date of 9/15/2026. The initial pool balance was 1,696,683,364.30, comprising 46,551 receivables with an average term of 55.8 months. Total original securities issued were 1,578,910,000.00.

During the period, the servicer collected 2,219,904.75 in interest and 17,316,632.07 in principal. After paying a servicing fee of 421,004.30 and a regular principal payment of 25,640,609.68, a residual amount of 1,795,395.12 was released to the depositor. The report confirms that no delinquency trigger occurred and no repurchase demands were made.

highlights.text: The Class A-3 note balance decreased from 286,450,758.48 at the beginning of the period to 260,810,148.80 at the end, reflecting the amortization of the notes.
Total payments to noteholders amounted to 27,376,314.14, which includes both principal and interest payments for the period.
The pool balance at the end of the period was 477,396,344.41, down from 505,205,155.09 at the beginning, indicating ongoing principal collection and pool reduction.
Cumulative net loss for all collection periods reached 9,976,739.65, while the net loss for the current period was 436,001.87.

risks.text: Delinquent receivables totaled 8,223,108.90, representing 1.72% of the end-of-period pool balance, involving 277 receivables.
Repossessed inventory stood at 1,190,026.69 across 31 receivables, indicating assets that have been repossessed but not yet liquidated.
A total of 203 receivables with a value of $6,728,141.78 were extended, which may impact cash flow timing and pool performance.
The specified reserve balance remained at 3,947,285.02 with no change in the reserve account balance during the period.
